title: Filipino Chicken Tinola
description: A traditional Filipino chicken soup made with ginger and onions. It's a comforting and flavorful meal perfect for any occasion.

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.amount: 1 whole chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: tinola
ingredients.amount: 1 tablespoon of tinola powder (or to taste)

instructions: Heat the chicken broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced ginger and chopped onion to the pot and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the chicken pieces to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the fish sauce, black pepper, and tinola powder to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the chicken tinola hot, garnished with chopped green onions and a squeeze of fresh calamansi juice if desired.
